testcase.name: SEL-01 Anonymous protected routes
testcase.system-out: Student, instructor and admin pages redirected signed-out Chrome to login.

testcase.name: SEL-02 Wrong password in the login form
testcase.system-out: Real login-form submission rejected a wrong password; Chrome remained signed out. No SMS/OTP delivery was performed.

testcase.name: SEL-03 Authenticated identity and reload
testcase.system-out: Credentials-endpoint fixture session displayed the correct student dashboard and survived reload. Complete delivered-OTP UI login is outside this check.

testcase.name: SEL-04 Student and instructor role boundaries
testcase.system-out: Selenium navigation denied all four student privileged routes and the instructor superadmin review route.

testcase.name: SEL-05 Owned course selector and empty exam builder
testcase.system-out: Owned draft/published options and blank question verified; foreign course absent and global option disabled.

testcase.name: SEL-06 Global exam request and approval
testcase.system-out: Teacher request persisted PENDING; superadmin UI approval unlocked the global exam option.

testcase.name: SEL-07 Publish a targeted global exam
testcase.system-out: Selenium created a global exam; MongoDB persisted SCHOOL + normalized science + the selected student ID.

testcase.name: SEL-08 Targeted exam discovery and direct access
testcase.system-out: Selected School learner saw the banner and exam. College learner saw neither listing nor private detail through the copied URL.

testcase.name: SEL-09 Contest permission is independent
testcase.system-out: Contest global option remained locked after exam approval, then unlocked after a separate request and superadmin approval.

testcase.name: SEL-10 Targeted contest creation and exclusions
testcase.system-out: Teacher published a real targeted contest; University CSE listing/detail succeeded and EEE listing/direct access were denied.

testcase.name: SEL-11 Administrator assigns an existing course
testcase.system-out: Superadmin UI assignment added the existing course to the teacher’s assessment selector; MongoDB owner was unchanged.

testcase.name: SEL-12 Profile changes immediately update eligibility
testcase.system-out: Selenium changed Science to Humanities, verified persistence and immediate direct-link exclusion, then restored Science.

testcase.name: SEL-13 Create a course with no profile image
testcase.system-out: Real course form created the course, module and lesson without a profile image; ownership and reopened curriculum passed.

testcase.name: SEL-14 Draft course direct link
testcase.system-out: Direct URL to a draft course displayed the not-found page in signed-out Chrome.

testcase.name: SEL-15 Free enrollment and duplicate prevention
testcase.system-out: Real free enrollment opened the course; reload retained access and exactly one enrollment record.

testcase.name: SEL-16 Lesson completion persists
testcase.system-out: Completion button wrote one actual lesson-progress record; after reload one of two lessons displayed 50%.

testcase.name: SEL-17 Revision request waits for review
testcase.system-out: Student modal submitted a real revision request; MongoDB remained PENDING with isRevisionGranted=false.

testcase.name: SEL-18 Revision queue ownership
testcase.system-out: Unrelated instructor queue omitted the private revision request and showed its empty state.

testcase.name: SEL-19 Owner approval grants temporary access
testcase.system-out: Course owner approved through Selenium; reviewer and seven-day grant were saved and the student saw active revision access.

testcase.name: SEL-20 Keyboard MCQ selection and modal return
testcase.system-out: Selenium keyboard input reached options, changed selection with Space/Enter and preserved the final answer after returning from review.

testcase.name: SEL-21 Grading, persistence and cooldown label
testcase.system-out: Real UI submission persisted 1.75/6, 29%, failed: one correct, one wrong and one skipped. Reload retained one submission and did not show the false attempt-limit warning at one of two attempts.

testcase.name: SEL-22 Empty dashboard has no invented progress
testcase.system-out: Dashboard for a learner with zero enrollments showed no fabricated 67% or 30/45-minute progress.

testcase.name: SEL-23 Actual PDF viewer and resource visibility
SEL-24 Responsive principal pages
testcase.system-out: Login, course detail, exam form and contest form had no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px window sizes.

testcase.name: SEL-25 Language preference and profile preservation
testcase.system-out: Selenium switched to Bangla, reloaded successfully, switched back to English and verified the saved Science department.

testcase.name: SEL-26 Missing course, exam and contest links
testcase.system-out: Selenium verified safe not-found states for nonexistent course, exam and contest links.

testcase.name: SEL-27 Signout removes protected navigation
testcase.system-out: Navbar signout removed the session; revisiting the student dashboard redirected to login.

testcase.name: SEL-28 Read navigation does not reseed content
testcase.system-out: Selenium navigation/reloads left user, course, exam, contest and notification counts unchanged; no sample reseeding.

testcase.name: SEL-X01 Delivered OTP signup/login

skipped.message: No configured SMS provider and controlled receiving phone. No SMS was sent; fixture session setup does not verify OTP delivery.

testcase.name: SEL-X02 Real Google consent login

skipped.message: No team-controlled Google consent session. Provider signup/login and cancellation require interactive account-holder access.

testcase.name: SEL-X03 Real owner and Test Admin login

skipped.message: Fixture role sessions are verified; real account-holder sessions were not provided and no credentials were reset.

testcase.name: SEL-X04 Physical mobile protected playback

skipped.message: This Selenium run used desktop Chrome only. No physical mobile browser was connected; earlier emulation results are separate.
